properties.summary: Illustrative massing: the approved 14-story, 185-ft office building traced from the floor plates of the December 2019 plan set, in four tiers that step back from Harrison Street, its western (Phase I) and eastern (Phase II) parts split at 759 Harrison Street. The 2022 modification takes in that lot, which these 2019 plans leave out; its plans weren't available. Terraces, open spaces and mechanical screens are not drawn, and nothing is drawn on the affordable housing lot.
properties.note: The approved building as simple volumes at its floor and roof heights, not the final design.

controls.label: Harrison Street frontage of lot 113, midpoint

georeference.method: The 4th Street, Harrison Street and Perry Street property lines of the plans and the notch around lot 113 matched to DataSF parcel vertices (lot 152, and lot 113 before its 2022 merger) by a least-squares similarity.

properties.license: Footprints: traced from a public SF Planning document. Georeference: DataSF parcels (ODC-PDDL).
